name: cwi_catalog_search
description: Search the verified That Boy Hi Hat 24-track catalog (Cumulative Web Inc machine-data layer). Reads catalog.json and datasets/tracks.jsonl — both verified live 2026-09-15. Use for: find a track by title, check explicit flags (Spotify metadata), get verified Spotify URLs, see producer notes. Truth-only: stream counts beyond the owner's stated ~307k lifetime for 'Zooted Zone' are not asserted.

query.description: Track title (or fragment) to search, e.g. 'Zooted Zone', 'Diabolique'.

include_metadata.description: Include explicit flags, producer notes, platform links where present.
